# The Advantages of Non-Wearable Fall Detection Devices: MDsense by Essence SmartCare

The Advantages of Non-Wearable Fall Detection Devices: MDsense...

April 25, 2024

![](https://www.essence-grp.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/MDsense-radar-based-fall-detector-1024x505.png)

**In the realm of senior care and aging-in-place solutions, non-wearable fall detection devices have emerged as a game-changer, offering peace of mind and safety for seniors and their caregivers in a non-intrusive yet reliable way. Among the solutions available on the market, MDsense by Essence SmartCare stands out as a cutting-edge fall detection system designed to revolutionize how falls are detected and responded to in homes and retirement facilities.**

A significant challenge faced by elderly individuals is that they often neglect or refuse to wear panic buttons or pendants with fall detection capabilities at home. Many seniors may not perceive the need for such devices or simply forget to wear them regularly. This lack of compliance poses a serious issue, as it increases the risk of critical situations that could have been avoided with timely intervention. Recognizing this problem, Essence SmartCare developed a radar-based non-wearable fall detection solution that operates 24/7 without requiring active participation from the end-user. This innovative technology provides a passive level of care during times when seniors are most vulnerable, ensuring their safety and well-being even when they may not be wearing traditional wearable devices.

### **What is MDsense?**

[MDsense](https://www.essencesmartcare.com/products/mdsense-fall-detector/?utm_source=website&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=blog&utm_content=advantages-of-non-wearable-fall-detection-devices-mdsense "Opens in new window") is a non-intrusive, wireless, ambient fall detector that sets itself apart with its complete indoor fall detection capabilities, utilizing an advanced algorithm and state-of-the-art technology to detect falls without a wearable detection device. Whether it’s a brightly lit room or total darkness, MDsense ensures immediate fall detection and seamlessly integrates with Essence’s [Care@Home™](https://www.essencesmartcare.com/solutions/care-at-home/?utm_source=website&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=blog&utm_content=advantages-of-non-wearable-fall-detection-devices-mdsense "Opens in new window") alert and monitoring system to ensure a timely response by caregivers or emergency services.

**![](https://www.essence-grp.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/MDsense-infographics-how-it-works-1024x503.png)**

### **MDsense’s unique benefits**

MDsense offers unparalleled accuracy and provides comprehensive coverage for any space in a discreet and non-intrusive way. The detector’s benefits are manifold, offering a level of assurance and reliability that traditional wearable fall detection devices struggle to match.

**Immediate Alarm:** MDsense triggers an immediate alarm upon detecting a fall, ensuring prompt response and intervention in critical situations.

**Accurate Fall Verification:** Leveraging AI, MDsense delivers precise fall verification, minimizing false alarms.

**Identifies Resident’s Position:** By pinpointing the resident’s location post-fall, MDsense facilitates rapid assistance, minimizing the risk of prolonged immobilization.

**Works in Total Darkness:** MDsense remains operational round-the-clock, even in dimly lit or pitch-black environments.

**Easy to Install and Operate:** Powered by batteries, MDsense is easy to install and operate, making it an ideal choice for both homeowners and retirement facilities.

**Full Coverage for Various Locations:** With its multi-zone lens and extensive room detection coverage, MDsense provides comprehensive protection across different living spaces.

### **MDsense: tailored to meet diverse needs**

With a range of advanced features designed to enhance its functionality and versatility, MDsense is tailored to meet the diverse needs of seniors and their caregivers. For **individual use**, MDsense provides discreet fall detection without the need for wearable devices and immediately notifies a monitoring center or family members in the event of an emergency. In **senior care facilities**, MDsense provides comprehensive coverage of private and public areas, with just a few devices effectively protecting all residents. In **challenging environments such as bathrooms**, which are prone to slips and falls, MDsense’s waterproof design ensures reliable detection, minimizing the risk of accidents and increasing overall safety for seniors.

### **A paradigm shift in fall detection technology**

MDsense represents a paradigm shift in fall detection technology, offering unparalleled accuracy, reliability, and convenience in safeguarding the well-being of seniors. With its non-intrusive ambient design, advanced features, and seamless integration with Essence’s Care@Home™ system, MDsense stands out as an innovative aging-in-place solution that empowers seniors to live independently while providing caregivers with invaluable peace of mind.
